items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: I got a call from Bill Ratzenberg, he's putting music into an old club up there... and he called me up. I'm supposed to go up there

ctx.x: No, you told me last time to jump ahead a little bit, you told me last time that you had lost that trumpet.

I have and I haven't found it either. And I got a call from Bill Ratzenberg, he's putting music into an old club up there, a country club, and he's putting together packages now and he called me up. I'm supposed to go up there and he said to be sure and bring your horn. I don't know, I haven't broken the news to him yet that I haven't got the horn. I don't know whether I should break the news to him and let him give me another one or go out and try to find a replacement. I'm weighing that situation.
